name: zoomguru
description: ZoomGuru — Your invisible AI interview copilot
author: ZoomGuru <support@zoomguru.xyz>

scripts.build:native: cd native/wgc-exclude && npm install && npm run build:electron || echo Native module not found, skipping
scripts.clean: taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM ZoomGuru.exe /T 2>nul & npx --yes rimraf dist-release release
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean && npm run build:native && npm run build && cross-env NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run build:native && npm run build && cross-env NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:win: npm run clean && npm run build:native && npm run build && cross-env NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
